_README: Canonical bench registry for this machine. ONE copy, at
C:/dev/qmx-panadapter/tools/bench.json - every worktree reads it by
absolute path. Never copy it into another tree; edit it here.
Paths use forward slashes deliberately: PowerShell accepts them and it
keeps this file free of backslash escaping.
Runtime state (who holds the build lock, who holds the antenna) lives in
the lock file, NOT here. This file is the plan; the lock is the moment.

antenna.note: One antenna, two radios, a 2-way switch. Only ONE bench is on air at a time. The spare switch position feeds a dummy load, so a TX on the off-antenna bench is safe. Record the holder with 'bench antenna <name>' - decode counts and noise floor from the antenna-less bench are meaningless.

benches.name: dev
benches.role: ON LOAN TO THE WSPR WORK since 2026-08-26 - see tree/branch below.
role_note: This bench normally runs the newest main commit. It is the WSPR
development board at the moment because 'lab', which is supposed to
do that job, has never been given a COM port.
tree/branch below describe WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON IT, because that is
what 'bench flash dev' builds from. A stale entry here does not read
as wrong - it silently flashes the other tree's firmware over this
one and then PASSES the MAC verify, because the board is the right
board. Put both back to C:/dev/qmx-panadapter + main when the WSPR
branch lands or moves to lab.
benches.ip_note: DHCP, so it drifts - a convenience, not the authority. The board prints its own address at boot ('sta ip:' in its capture). qmx.local is NOT a discriminator: every unit answers to it, and on 2026-08-27 it resolved to a different board entirely.

benches.name: lab
benches.role: Feature branch of the day (wspr, cw). Flashed freely. NOT WIRED UP - no COM port assigned, so its work is running on 'dev' instead.
benches.mac: UNKNOWN - fill in from the first boot line

benches.name: field
benches.radio_note: Borrow the small QMX if a release touches radio behaviour.
benches.usb_flash_reason: This unit has never been USB-flashed. That provenance is what makes an OTA result credible - it is the only board that proves an update path a real user would take. Update it over the air only. If it must ever be recovered by USB, say so explicitly and update this field, because the OTA evidence resets with it.

benches.name: port
benches.role: Multi-board port to the Waveshare P4. Private remote.
benches.mac: UNKNOWN - fill in from the first boot line
benches.radio_note: Borrow the small QMX for the USB-host and parity phases.
benches.warning: This board was once partially flashed with Tab5 firmware at 94% and boot-looped, because VID_303A was assumed to mean Tab5. It is NOT a Tab5 and must never receive a qmx-panadapter main-tree binary.
